description: Argent fervor - a crusader whose strikes echo in holy light.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 37 real CoA Crusader talents (role DPS), completing Templar. LIGHT'S CHOSEN PORTS WHOLE - spell power from Agility and crit from Intellect are both legal pairs - making this the third double conversion in the class. Templar is the best-served class in the audit for conversions. Retribution uses bonus_pct, which reads the triggering hit's own amount, so CoA's '2 additional strikes for 30% of the damage dealt' is exact at 60%. Condemn stacks cannot be read and four talents read them. Owns righteous_tempest at tier 4, the only one of Templar's three gated abilities not at tier 6.

nodes.name: Light's Chosen
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 30% of your Agility and your spell critical strike chance by 15% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive, verbatim: 'Increases your spell power by 30% of your Agility and your critical strike rating by 15% of your Intellect.' PORTS WHOLE - spell_power and crit_chance_spell are both in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, agility and intellect both in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES. The third double conversion in Templar, after Zealot's Calm Combatant and Oathkeeper's Graceful Fighter. Both are FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Aggramar's Rage
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 6% and your expertise by 10.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Holy critical strike chance by 3% and your expertise by 5.' Doubled for the two ranks. There is no per-school crit key, so Holy crit becomes spell crit - this spec's spell damage is all Holy. BOTH HALVES PORT because creature avoidance went in earlier today, making `expertise` a real stat; before that it reduced a target dodge and parry that did not exist. Both keys are PERCENT.

nodes.name: Pure Focus
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 3% and the damage of Chastise by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the chance to trigger Scourgebane by 5% and your chance to hit by 2%.' FRONTIER HAS NO SCOURGEBANE ABILITY, and a 'chance to trigger' it would need the proc that does not exist either. The hit half is doubled for the two ranks and ports; the Scourgebane half is re-pointed at Chastise, which CoA's Righteousness node pairs with Scourgebane.

nodes.name: Chivalric
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your critical damage with Holy spells and abilities by 15%.' No per-school crit damage key exists, so it lands on the physical side - this spec's damage is weapon strikes typed Holy, and crit_damage_physical is what scales them. A FRACTION, unlike crit_chance_physical which is a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Paladin Training
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Righteous Lunge and Argent Blade by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Righteous Lunge and Argent Blade by 20%.' Ports exactly - both abilities exist in Frontier and both are combo generators.

nodes.name: Warrior of Tyr
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 10% chance to restore 5 combo.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to generate 5 Energy.' Periodic damage has no trigger, so it fires off casts. CoA's Energy is Frontier's COMBO, a real primary pool (abilities.py:164) with six generators - so there IS somewhere for this to go, verified on the Zealot tree through gain_resource. CoA's 10% and 5 both kept.

nodes.name: Retribution
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 20% chance to echo, striking again for 60% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Melee damage dealt now has a 20% chance to strike 2 additional times for 30% of the damage dealt as Holy Damage.' USES bonus_pct, which adds a percentage of the TRIGGERING HIT's own amount to that same hit - one of only three payloads that read the damage dealt. Two strikes at 30% is 60%, and CoA's 20% chance is exact. WHAT IS LOST IS THE HOLY TYPING: bonus_pct folds into the same hit and takes no school, unlike damage_flat, so the extra damage inherits the strike's own school. Same payload as Pyromancer Draconic's Aspect of Time.

nodes.name: Warrior of Dawn
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 10% chance to ready Argent Blade again.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Melee damage dealt now has a 10% chance to reset the cooldown and reduce the Energy cost of your next Argent Blade by -50%.' The reset ports exactly - reset_cooldown as a BARE LIST means a full reset, and CoA's 10% is kept. The cost reduction on a NAMED NEXT CAST has no mechanism, so it is dropped rather than made permanent; Scourge-Defense Training below carries the empowerment half instead.

nodes.name: Scourge-Defense Training
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Argent Blade by 12% and its critical strike chance by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Warrior of Dawn now also increases the damage and critical strike chance of your next Argent Blade by 20%.' A talent modifying another talent's proc to empower a named next cast fails twice over. Granted flat on the ability itself at CoA's own 20% for both halves - which is what the empowerment delivered, without the setup. Note the units differ: ability_*_damage is a FRACTION, ability_*_crit a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Righteousness
nodes.description: Chastise leaves the enemy taking 10% more damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Chastise now always triggers Scourgebane on your target.' FRONTIER HAS NO SCOURGEBANE, so there is nothing to trigger. Rebuilt as the debuff a guaranteed Scourgebane represented - Chastise marking a target for more damage. BARE damage_taken_pct IS READ RAW, so 10% is 0.10; authoring 10.0 would be +1000% damage taken.

nodes.name: Teachings of the Cathedral
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Oath: Condemn now provides 5% additional critical strike chance.' Oaths do not exist (see the Zealot builder) and NOTHING READS ANOTHER EFFECT'S STACK COUNT, so a talent that improves what a Condemn stack provides has nothing to improve. Granted as flat crit at CoA's own 5%. This is the first of four Condemn-stack talents in this tree, all re-pointed.

nodes.name: Tyr's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Condemn by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Condemn now stacks 1 additional time.' NO KEY MODIFIES ANOTHER EFFECT'S max_stacks - the same wall that took Venomancer Fortitude's Beetle Poison and Pyromancer Incineration's Flames of Focus - so an extra stack cannot be granted. Re-pointed at Condemn's damage, which is what another stack was worth.

nodes.name: Templar's Might
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Righteous Lunge and Chastise by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Righteous Lunge and Chastise used on enemies affected by your Condemn now deal 6% increased damage per stack.' Two walls: no effect key reads whether a target carries a debuff, and nothing reads a stack count. Five Condemn stacks at 6% is 30%, granted flat - the ceiling a fully-stacked target would have reached.

nodes.name: Scarlet Secrets
nodes.description: Your critical strikes raise your critical strike chance by 5% for 4 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Every 2nd cast of Argent Blade now grants you Oath: Retribution. Critical damage increased by 5%.' THERE IS NO CAST COUNTER - nothing tracks 'every Nth cast of X', the same wall as Venomancer Stalking's Widow's Kiss - so it fires on crits instead, which a Crusader does often. CoA's 5% kept and allowed to stack 3 times to give the node a ramp. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT crit_damage_physical takes percentage POINTS, so 5.0 is 5% - while the SAME KEY on Chivalric at tier 0 is a FRACTION at 0.15.

nodes.name: Focused
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Blade of Faith and Righteous Tempest by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Blade of Faith and Righteous Tempest by 25%.' Ports exactly - both exist in Frontier. Righteous Tempest is unlocked at tier 4 below, so this node is worth taking alongside it.

nodes.name: Holy Tempest
nodes.description: Righteous Tempest splashes 40% of its damage onto up to 3 nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Righteous Tempest now spreads Condemn on affected enemies to a nearby enemy.' SPREADING A DEBUFF TO A NEW TARGET IS NOT A PAYLOAD - apply_effect lands on the trigger's own target - so it becomes splash_damage, the same translation as the Witch Doctor's Malignant and Pyromancer Draconic's Overwhelming Flames.

nodes.name: Judgement
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Scarlet Hammer and Titanstrike by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Scourgebane, Scarlet Hammer, and Titanstrike by 25% on enemies below 20% health.' Scourgebane does not exist in Frontier. NO EFFECT KEY READS A TARGET'S HEALTH PERCENTAGE - high_health_damage_threshold_pct is dead and the working low_health pair on Venomancer Fortitude is about the carrier's own health - so the execute condition is dropped and CoA's 25% applies always.

nodes.name: Crusader's Brand
nodes.description: Your strikes brand the enemy, so their own attacks burn them for holy damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Brand an enemy for 20 seconds, preventing them from mounting, fleeing, or increasing their movement speed above normal, and when they deal direct damage they take Holy Damage. While marked enemies can always be seen by the Crusader even while stealthed or invisible.' Frontier HAS Crusader's Brand as an ability and it is not gated. NOTHING TRIGGERS ON THE TARGET DEALING DAMAGE - there is no attacker-side retaliation hook on a debuff - so the brand becomes a dot, which burns them on the same schedule without needing them to swing. Movement and stealth are not modelled.

nodes.name: Righteous Tempest
nodes.description: Teaches Righteous Tempest, a whirling holy strike that hits everything nearby.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Unleash a whirling Oath Breaker, dealing Weapon Damage plus spell damage to nearby enemies every 1 sec for 3 sec. Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: templar_righteous_tempest carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. It is the ONLY one of Templar's three gated abilities not at tier 6 - Zealot's Norgannon's Wrath and Oathkeeper's Tome of Light are both capstones - and it is kept at tier 4 exactly where the shipped tree had it. The Oath consumption lives on the ability or not at all.

nodes.name: Whirling Tempest
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 9%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'While Righteous Tempest is active you gain 20% increased movement speed.' MOVEMENT SPEED IS NOT MODELLED and there is no 'while active' gate either. Rerouted to haste, which is what speed means in a turn-based fight - acting more often. NOT a faithful copy and flagged as such.

nodes.name: Scarlet Training
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's own description for this node is the unresolved token '$66' - the Builder payload never expands it - so there is no verbatim text and this is NOT a faithful copy. Named from CoA's own title and built as flat damage. Flagged so a later pass can correct it; the same situation as Zealot's Divine Fury ('$64'), Incineration's Magmatic ('$8a') and Draconic's Draconic Aspect ('$8e').

nodes.name: Holy Fervor
nodes.description: Argent Blade heals you for 30% of the damage it deals.
nodes._source: CoA's Argent Blade: 'Crush an enemy with argent fervor, dealing Weapon Damage plus holy spell power, healing you equal to the damage dealt, and extending the duration of your Oath Chain by 3 sec.' The self-heal is the ability's own in CoA; this node makes it a talent because leech_pct READS THE TRIGGERING HIT'S AMOUNT, so the scaling is real. Priced at 30% rather than CoA's 100%, which on a 160%-weapon-damage strike would make the spec a tank. The Oath Chain extension cannot be built.

nodes.name: Templar's Zeal
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your strikes by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's Pure Focus and Aggramar's Rage both point at crit, and this node carries the per-ability version neither does - written out across all six combo builders, since no key names a group. NOT a direct port of a single CoA talent: built so tier 5 carries a real stat node for the rotation rather than a fourth flat damage line, and flagged as such.

nodes.name: Crusading Strike
nodes.description: Your critical strikes strike again for holy damage.
nodes._source: Built from CoA's Retribution theme - 'strike additional times as Holy Damage' - but as a FLAT holy strike rather than a bonus_pct, deliberately: Retribution at tier 1 already uses bonus_pct, and a damage_flat payload is the only way to get HOLY TYPING, since bonus_pct folds into the triggering hit and inherits its school. So the two nodes read differently in play. NOT a direct port of a single CoA talent and flagged as such. 1-turn icd.

nodes.name: Titanstrike
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Titanstrike and Scarlet Hammer by 27%, and all damage you deal by 5%.
nodes._source: Templar's three gated abilities are one per tree and this tree's sits at tier 4 (Righteous Tempest), so unlike Zealot and Oathkeeper this capstone grants no ability - it is a pure payoff node. Built on CoA's execute pair, Titanstrike and Scarlet Hammer, which Judgement at tier 3 also feeds, plus flat damage. The shipped tree had no tier-6 node at all for Crusader, so this is new rather than a rebuild, and it is NOT a port of a specific CoA talent - flagged as such.
